snippet_primary: "BUYERS BEWARE: I purchased a chrome extension for $17 that didn't work. I never received a receipt and the extension didn't work with no contact info for the developer. I contacted support after multiple AI email responses, was forced to open a chargeback. TERRIBLE customer service. I wish I'd checked into this website before purchasing this extension."
